supersedes: tools/round-50/gap-rule.json (frozen; a per-row required disposition for char-device entries, generalised from the Cable-carrier class where one char device exists)

class_disposition.char-device: not-publishable-by-design: an extractor that writes regular files cannot create a device node, so no per-row gap record can exist for this class; the class is accounted for by the re-derived oracle table (every char-device row re-derived from the carrier bytes by unsquashfs) and by the nonregular_unpublished check (no published regular file may equal a char-device path). A gap that names a char device is still allowed and counted.
class_disposition.block-device: not-publishable-by-design, same reason; no block-device row exists on these four carriers.
